event_rules.generation: group integer; distinct tile/store strings for non-group lifetime
event_rules.signal_wait: one outstanding signal per direction/id, consumed exactly once
event_rules.co1_release: V_M after complete UB readback, before the next Cube issue
event_rules.slot_release: V_MTE2 after correction/addition, never merely after load submission
event_rules.operand_release: M_V after Cube consumes both activation limbs and weight
event_rules.store_release: MTE3_V after projected FP16 output store
event_rules.control_event: ID 2 for expert-cache and output-store lifetimes; all slot tokens are drained before reuse
event_rules.pipe_v: cast and correction dependencies require explicit vector ordering

projection.output_tile_assignment: tile = block_id + k*8; no duplicated writes
projection.column_windows: optional first_tile/count<=8; full bank strides retained; output uses window stride
projection.product: paired low/high INT4 MMAD: m=32,n=128,k=128; CO1/UB [N/16,2*M,16]
projection.projection_boundary: FP16 CAST_NONE after all G128 groups
projection.bulk: 16 live rows; strip or row loop respecting paired layout
projection.sparse: 1..15 live rows; row loop only over live rows
projection.peer_rows: every peer FP16 row explicitly zeroed before completed launch is consumed; no stale graph output
projection.metadata: three FP16 banks cached once per expert/output tile; bank base=N*MAX_GROUPS; strip stride=actual groups*16; cast cached FP16 directly to per-slot FP32
projection.decode: existing bounded decode remains separate; no automatic replacement

epilogue.paired_gate_owner: same core owns gate N128 columns and matching up N128 columns; reserve FP16 gate while computing up
epilogue.qualified_reference: cann_builtin_fp16 requires surviving projected GM boundary until nonlinear parity is proven
epilogue.fp32_candidate: separate explicit ABI; unqualified against builtin FP16; no implicit activation precision substitution
epilogue.handoff: packed low/high hidden plus FP32 scale/sum written to GM; down depends on multiple column owners; same-core shortcut unsupported

whole_rank.qualification: unknown; must reject before hardware allocation
whole_rank.host_spill_capacity: separate host budget; never credit against NPU bytes
